dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: ...And in summary, that's the commission we're here for. How's that sound to you, Jahoda?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: All the same to me. You should ask yourself one question though... You wanna catch someone in Nod-Krai, how many lives are you prepared to lose for it?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hahaha, well, I once read a story. It told me that if I find a deer with divinity, I could use its antlers to take my place for one death.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: And what do you know? "Deer" happens to be one of the Inazuman characters in my name, and I've got my own life to spare. That makes two.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: #{NICKNAME}? What a coincidence. What are you doing in Nod-Krai? Another stop on your journey, perhaps?

choices.text: What are YOU doing in Nod-Krai, Heizou?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Sharp. Heh, I'm here in pursuit of a fugitive who fled Inazuma. He's racked up a real rap sheet, and he's always trying to flee further and further abroad.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: A few months ago, we received intel that he was hiding out in Nod-Krai and had joined a band of bandits. He soon returned to his usual M.O. — that is to say, robbing homes and raiding caravans.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: I think they called themselves the... Seahook Gang, or something? Word is they're quite a big deal in Nod-Krai, and have taken in a fair share of exiled criminals from across Teyvat...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: After that, I knocked on the doors of the Curatorium of Secrets, Mora in hand, and asked the boss to get me someone who could point me in the direction of this Seahook Gang.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And that someone is Jahoda?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: That's right. Judging by your expression... I'm guessing you're acquainted?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: I can tell. My intuition tells me that if Jahoda became a thief, even I'd never be able to catch her.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: ...Eh, you can cut the chatter. Boss Nef gave me the job, so it's only natural I'd be good at it.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: But the Seahook Gang you're looking for isn't the original Seahook crew.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: The original gang's long since disbanded. The people callin' themselves that now are just riding on the name and scamming folks left and right.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You really have all the intel, huh, Jahoda?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Haha... Yeah, I guess I do, huh...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Interesting. This is news to me. Would you mind telling me more about this new gang of impostors, Jahoda?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: What's there to tell? New or old, fake or real, the Seahook Gang are bandits.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: A bunch of scoundrels who banded together for Mora, then fell out over it.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Their old leader wound up thrown overboard as fish food, while the underlings fought among themselves for the scraps.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Some died, and others continued their wanderings. The long and short of it is that the old Seahook Gang are dead, gone, or both.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Wait, doesn't that mean some of the suspects within could have started going around committing crimes again?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: When a house goes poof, the snakes and rats nestled within find other walls to burrow into. That's just how it is. Nobody wants to die out in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Hahaha, but for all the vermin out there, it's also the perfect time to find a good place to settle down, and maybe get a good roommate along the way.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: If I were a rat, escaping the snake would mean freedom from being hunted down and eaten... When you think about it, that's a good thing.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: In any case, you've been most helpful, Jahoda. Thank you for the intel. It seems the Mora spent on your services was well worth it.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: It's honestly a real load off to know that these people are just impostors using the Seahook Gang's name.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: I'd have had to admit I was in over my head flying solo against the real gang, with its international cohort of goons and all.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Well, wait.. You think you can take 'em on as they are now, all by yourself?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Hmm... Yeah, more or less. After all, I'm only looking for our Inazuman fugitive. I'm not here to bring the whole gang to justice.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Hmph, that's a bold statement... but whatever. I'll help you track the impostors down. What happens after... that's got nothing to do with me.

choices.text: How about I go with you?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Your kindness is appreciated, but this time, I'd rather this be a solo outing.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Now, I suppose that's that. I'll leave locating them to you, Jahoda.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: As for me, I'll get to thinking of how I can haul this scoundrel back to Inazuma and have him confess his crimes...

choices.text: That way, we can round the whole gang up.
